Human.description: Humans are the most adaptable and ambitious people among the common races. Whatever drives them, humans are the innovators, the achievers, and the pioneers of the worlds.

traits.name: Versatile
traits.description: Humans are known for their adaptability, reflected in their balanced ability scores and broad potential.

Variant Human.description: Humans who customize their abilities further, gaining a specific skill and a feat.

traits.name: Skills
traits.description: You gain proficiency in one skill of your choice.

traits.name: Feat
traits.description: You gain one feat of your choice.

effects.notes: Variant Human Feat Choice (Feat system TBD)

Elf.description: Elves are a magical people of otherworldly grace, living in the world but not entirely part of it. They live long lives and are often perceived as aloof and unconcerned with the affairs of 'shorter-lived' races.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.description: Accustomed to twilit forests and the night sky, you have superior vision in dark and dim conditions. You can see in dim light within 60 feet of you as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light. You can’t discern color in darkness, only shades of gray.

traits.name: Keen Senses
traits.description: You have proficiency in the Perception skill.

traits.name: Fey Ancestry
traits.description: You have advantage on saving throws against being charmed, and magic can’t put you to sleep.

traits.name: Trance
traits.description: Elves don’t need to sleep. Instead, they meditate deeply, remaining semiconscious, for 4 hours a day. After resting in this way, you gain the same benefit that a human does from 8 hours of sleep.

effects.name: Trance
effects.details: Meditate for 4 hours for long rest benefits.

High Elf.description: High elves are heirs of a long line of elven wizards and warriors, valuing study and artistry. They are often found in places of learning and ancient power.

traits.name: Elf Weapon Training
traits.description: You have proficiency with the longsword, shortsword, shortbow, and longbow.

traits.name: Cantrip
traits.description: You know one cantrip of your choice from the wizard spell list. Intelligence is your spellcasting ability for it.

Wood Elf.description: Wood elves are nimble and stealthy hunters, at home in the depths of ancient forests. They are known for their keen senses and ability to move like shadows.

traits.name: Elf Weapon Training
traits.description: You have proficiency with the longsword, shortsword, shortbow, and longbow.

traits.name: Fleet of Foot
traits.description: Your base walking speed increases to 35 feet.

traits.name: Mask of the Wild
traits.description: You can attempt to hide even when you are only lightly obscured by foliage, heavy rain, falling snow, mist, and other natural phenomena.

effects.name: Mask of the Wild
effects.details: Can attempt to hide when only lightly obscured by natural phenomena.

Dwarf.description: Dwarves are stout and resilient folk, known for their skill in smithing, mining, and warfare. They value tradition, clan, and the treasures of the earth.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.description: Accustomed to life underground, you have superior vision in dark and dim conditions. You can see in dim light within 60 feet of you as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light. You can’t discern color in darkness, only shades of gray.

traits.name: Dwarven Resilience
traits.description: You have advantage on saving throws against poison, and you have resistance against poison damage.

traits.name: Dwarven Combat Training
traits.description: You have proficiency with the battleaxe, handaxe, light hammer, and warhammer.

traits.name: Tool Proficiency
traits.description: You gain proficiency with the artisan’s tools of your choice: smith’s tools, brewer’s supplies, or mason’s tools.

traits.name: Stonecunning
traits.description: Whenever you make an Intelligence (History) check related to the origin of stonework, you are considered proficient in the History skill and add double your proficiency bonus to the check, instead of your normal proficiency bonus.

Hill Dwarf.description: Hill dwarves are known for their exceptional hardiness and strong intuition. They are often found in well-fortified communities in hilly terrains.

traits.name: Dwarven Toughness
traits.description: Your hit point maximum increases by 1, and it increases by 1 every time you gain a level.

Mountain Dwarf.description: Mountain dwarves are strong and heavily armored, accustomed to rugged mountain life. They are often more martial than their hill dwarf cousins.

traits.name: Dwarven Armor Training
traits.description: You have proficiency with light and medium armor.

Halfling.description: Halflings are cheerful and curious folk who value the comforts of home and hearth. They are known for their luck, bravery, and surprising agility.

traits.name: Lucky
traits.description: When you roll a 1 on an attack roll, ability check, or saving throw, you can reroll the die and must use the new roll.

traits.name: Brave
traits.description: You have advantage on saving throws against being frightened.

traits.name: Halfling Nimbleness
traits.description: You can move through the space of any creature that is of a size larger than yours.

effects.name: Halfling Nimbleness
effects.details: Can move through space of larger creatures.

Lightfoot Halfling.description: Lightfoot halflings are more prone to wanderlust than other halflings, and often possess a natural stealth that allows them to avoid notice.

traits.name: Naturally Stealthy
traits.description: You can attempt to hide even when you are obscured only by a creature that is at least one size larger than you.

effects.name: Naturally Stealthy
effects.details: Can hide when obscured by a creature one size larger.

Stout Halfling.description: Stout halflings are hardier than their cousins and have a strong resistance to toxins. They are often more settled and less prone to travel.

traits.name: Stout Resilience
traits.description: You have advantage on saving throws against poison, and you have resistance against poison damage.

Dragonborn.description: Dragonborn are proud, draconic humanoids who trace their ancestry to mighty dragons. They are known for their honor, martial prowess, and powerful breath weapons.

traits.name: Draconic Ancestry Feature
traits.description: Your breath weapon and damage resistance are determined by your chosen draconic ancestry.

effects.notes: Dragonborn Damage Resistance based on chosen ancestry

Gnome.description: Gnomes are small, curious humanoids known for their inventiveness, humor, and love of intricate mechanisms or the natural world.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.description: Accustomed to life underground, you have superior vision in dark and dim conditions...

traits.name: Gnome Cunning
traits.description: You have advantage on all Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma saving throws against magic.

Forest Gnome.description: Forest gnomes are shy and reclusive, preferring the tranquility of wooded areas. They have a natural talent for illusion and a kinship with small animals.

traits.name: Natural Illusionist
traits.description: You know the Minor Illusion cantrip. Intelligence is your spellcasting ability for it.

traits.name: Speak with Small Beasts
traits.description: Through sounds and gestures, you can communicate simple ideas with Small or smaller beasts.

effects.name: Speak with Small Beasts
effects.details: Can communicate simple ideas with Small or smaller beasts.
effects.notes: Forest Gnome Speak with Small Beasts

Rock Gnome.description: Rock gnomes are master artisans and engineers, fascinated by clockwork devices and invention. They are often found in bustling workshops and underground cities.

traits.name: Artificer's Lore
traits.description: Whenever you make an Intelligence (History) check related to magic items, alchemical objects, or technological devices, you can add twice your proficiency bonus, instead of your normal proficiency bonus.

traits.name: Tinker
traits.description: You have proficiency with artisan’s tools (tinker’s tools). Using those tools, you can spend 1 hour and 10 gp worth of materials to construct a Tiny clockwork device (AC 5, 1 hp) from three categories: Clockwork Toy, Fire Starter, or Music Box.

effects.name: Tinker Construct Device
effects.details: 1hr, 10gp to make clockwork toy, fire starter, or music box

Half-Elf.description: Half-elves combine the best qualities of their human and elven parentage. They are charismatic, versatile, and possess a touch of fey grace, often feeling like outsiders in both human and elven societies.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.description: Thanks to your elf blood, you have superior vision in dark and dim conditions...

traits.name: Fey Ancestry
traits.description: You have advantage on saving throws against being charmed, and magic can’t put you to sleep.

traits.name: Skill Versatility
traits.description: You gain proficiency in two skills of your choice.

Half-Orc.description: Half-orcs combine the strength and ferocity of their orcish heritage with the adaptability of humans. They are often intense individuals, driven by strong emotions and a desire to prove themselves.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.description: Thanks to your orc blood, you have superior vision in dark and dim conditions...

traits.name: Menacing
traits.description: You gain proficiency in the Intimidation skill.

traits.name: Relentless Endurance
traits.description: When you are reduced to 0 hit points but not killed outright, you can drop to 1 hit point instead. You can’t use this feature again until you finish a long rest.

traits.name: Savage Attacks
traits.description: When you score a critical hit with a melee weapon attack, you can roll one of the weapon’s damage dice one additional time and add it to the extra damage of the critical hit.

Tiefling.description: Tieflings are humanoids who carry the blood of fiends, granting them infernal power and a striking appearance. They often face suspicion but possess a strong sense of self and a natural charisma.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.description: Thanks to your infernal heritage, you have superior vision in dark and dim conditions...

traits.name: Hellish Resistance
traits.description: You have resistance to fire damage.

traits.name: Infernal Legacy
traits.description: You know the Thaumaturgy cantrip. At 3rd level, you can cast Hellish Rebuke (2nd-level) once per long rest. At 5th level, you can cast Darkness once per long rest. Charisma is your spellcasting ability.
